case "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" in ""|"$HOME"|"$HOME/") exit 0 ;; esac; out=$("$HOME/.security/malscan" --quiet "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" = 0 ] || printf '%s' "$out" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"SECURITY: malscan flagged this project. Do not run install/build commands until reviewed. Findings: "+sys.stdin.read()}}))'; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Scanning project for known malware patterns
